newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Wall St lifts slow Australian stocks at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall St lifts slow Australian stocks at open.

text.p: A slow Australian share market was lifted by Wall Street's rebound at the open on Wednesday with little local news to influence trading.
From the opening, the All Ordinaries index added 11.8 points to 2,327.6.
Brokers said trade was light with little to engender enthusiasm among investors as the market looked towards the Christmas break.
"It's been very quiet so far," said a Sydney-based dealer, adding that most leading stocks had made modest gains.
"Most are a bit firmer but CRA is feeling the pressure from RTZ which fell overnight."
CRA shares were trading at A$18.80 (US$14.96), down 15 cents on Tuesday's close.
Expectations were for a modestly higher close on the day although activity levels were seen as unlikely to reach any great heights.
"I'm hoping for 10 to 12 points out of the day but I'm not expecting great things."
Rises outnumbered falls by a ratio of about nine to four, while about 38 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
